info.name: Todo API
info.description: Full contract of the Todo API (auth, lists, tasks, subtasks, notes, reminders, tags). Run the folders in order: Auth registers a fresh user and stores its tokens, later folders reuse the ids they create, and Cleanup deletes them. Set baseUrl via the TodoApi.local environment (default http://localhost:5055).

exec: pm.test('Location header points at the list', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.include('/api/lists/' + pm.response.json().id));
pm.test('Defaults to Todo / priority 2', () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('Todo'); pm.expect(t.priority).to.eql(2); });

item.name: Create task - priority out of range (400)

exec: pm.test('Has detail collections', () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.subtasks).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(t.notes).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(t.reminders).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(t.tags).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Fields replaced', () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.title).to.eql('Write final report'); pm.expect(t.priority).to.eql(2); pm.expect(t.dueDate).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('Content updated', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().content).to.eql('Ask finance for Q3 and Q4 figures'));

pm.test('Due reminder carries the task title', () => { const due = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(due.map(r => r.id)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get('reminderId')]); pm.expect(due[0].taskTitle).to.eql('Write final report'); pm.expect(due[0].remindAt).to.eql('2026-10-31T09:00:00Z'); });

pm.test('Detail includes everything added', () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('Done'); pm.expect(t.subtasks).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(t.notes).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(t.reminders).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(t.tags.map(x => x.id)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get('tagId')]); });
